sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Puzzle Farm is a classic matching puzzle game, where you swap crops to create sets of three or more in a row. The game takes place on a grid, where crops of different colors and shapes are scattered about. Your goal is to swap crops to create sets of three or more in a row, either horizontally or vertically. As you clear these sets, you'll earn points and unlock new crops, game modes, and features. The game also features a variety of obstacles and challenges, such as bees, butterflies, and other pests that'll try to ruin your fun. But don't worry, with a little practice and strategy, you'll be able to overcome these obstacles and achieve Puzzle Farm mastery.
